title: chore: default `pnpm dev` to the showcase app + add dev:showcase
body:
Makes the **showcase** kitchen-sink example the default `pnpm dev` (it exercises every metadata type, view, chart, and the automation/AI/security chains — the best app to spin up to see/test the platform). CRM stays available explicitly.

- **package.json**: `dev` → showcase filter; add explicit `dev:showcase` (parallel to `dev:crm`/`dev:todo`); `dev:crm` retained.
- **README.md**: scripts table reflects the new default + adds `dev:showcase`/`dev:crm` rows.
- **AGENTS.md**: frontend-debug recipe leads with `PORT=3000 pnpm dev` (showcase), CRM as the alternative.

No CI depends on the bare `pnpm dev` default.
